# spec-memo v0.22.0
> Local working memory for coding agents outside the product repository.

## Summary
spec-memo gives AI coding agents a curated working memory outside the product git repository (at ~/.spec-memo/ or $SPEC_MEMO_ROOT). Repositories are mapped to projects via normalized git remote origin.

## Core Capabilities
- Default 8 KB bootstrap brief (raise via ~/.spec-memo/config.json bootstrap.maxBytes): Delivers ranked anti-regression traps, open decisions, and SHA drift alerts.
- SQLite FTS5 Disposable Index: Fast local search with Porter stemming.
- 11 MCP Tools: bootstrap, search, get, upsert, append, forget, gc, promote, check_version, install_skills, prompt.
- Server Transports & CLI: Stdio, HTTP/SSE on port 3123 (configurable), status monitor UI on port 3124, canvas graph UI on port 3125, and memo status diagnostic inspector.
- Deployment modes: local (default), hybrid (debounced HTTP delta sync with shared daemon), remote (stdio proxy; zero local records).
- Optional vault-git (config.json vaultGit): private git remote backup of ~/.spec-memo/. vaultGit.atomic defaults false (batched)—mutations write markdown only; git commit + pull/push flush on memo sync, prompt session_end, or graceful memo serve shutdown. atomic true restores per-mutation commit+push (fail-open). When hybrid and vaultGit are both enabled, memo sync runs both channels in parallel; either may fail without crashing MCP/SSE.

## Installation
npm install -g github:jpolvora/spec-memo
